'''Bower''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When [[Kasey]] gave up piracy for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] he followed her, out of loyalty and love, though he did not share her rebel leanings. He was part of the rebel cell [[Enid Vahr]] sought to establish in [[Byrne City]] just before the [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]] [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="BE" />
